song.title: The Man Who Sold The World

guitar.modelsText: Fender Mustang / Fender Jaguar / Martin D-18E
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Kurt Cobain's Mustang, Jaguar, and the Martin D-18E from MTV Unplugged are all extremely well documented.

tone.target: dirty grunge crunch with subtle modulation
tone.profile: dirty grunge crunch with subtle modulation
tone.summary: A crunchy, mid-scooped grunge tone achieved using a classic British amp model (UK 45) combined with light distortion and subtle chorus.

rig.name: Nirvana - The Man Who Sold The World - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide initial grit and crunch for the grunge sound.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a slightly broken, overdriven tube preamp characteristic of early 90s alternative rock.

alternatives.reason: Similar dirt boost but less vintage grit.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary dirty crunch and thickness to the low end.
blocks.gap: Using a general Distortion model rather than a specific fuzz/overdrive is best for maintaining definition while achieving grunge saturation.

alternatives.reason: Might be too aggressive or mid-focused.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British rock crunch and mid-scooped character.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is ideal for the vintage, slightly dirty tone required by Nirvana's sound palette.

alternatives.reason: Might be too clean or focused on a different era.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Add the required subtle modulation (chorus) without sounding artificial.
blocks.gap: The chorus is kept very subtle to avoid distracting from the core grunge tone.

alternatives.reason: Too rhythmic and noticeable for this specific track.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone by scooping mids and thickening the low end.
blocks.gap: This EQ stage is crucial for achieving the 'scooped mid' grunge sound profile.

alternatives.reason: Less precise control over specific frequency ranges.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space without creating distracting reverb tails.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring to provide natural, non-metallic ambience.

alternatives.reason: Can sound too bright or artificial for grunge.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and definition.

proposals.reason: Improve the vintage, slightly scooped sound profile of grunge.
